# Calendar dependencies

Vendored files, served locally (no runtime CDN requests):

- FullCalendar Standard 6.1.22: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fullcalendar@6.1.22/index.global.min.js
- Polish locale: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fullcalendar/core@6.1.22/locales/pl.global.min.js
- Luxon 3 adapter: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fullcalendar/luxon3@6.1.22/index.global.min.js
- Luxon 3.7.2: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/luxon@3.7.2/build/global/luxon.min.js

All are MIT licensed. Licenses are included alongside these files. Luxon handles Europe/Warsaw time independently of the browser's timezone, including daylight saving changes.
